t: Boy Epic Delivers a Visual Masterpiece With Music Video "DRAMA" – New Noise Magazine
s: July 10, 2019 - “‘DRAMA’ is the product of blending alternative realities and virtual simulations meant to transport listeners into a different state of mind and life,” explains Boy Epic. “The music video was inspired by a dystopian setting and chaotic uprise, allowing viewers to lose touch with reality and uncover the metaphorical hidden gem hidden within the song.” Produced by the acclaimed Jason Evigan, whose recent work has included artists SZA, G-Eazy and Maroon 5, the track perfectly encapsulates the hard-hitting sounds and catchy melody that transcend upon listeners on impact.
